title: TR-FactBench Example
description: Schema for TR-FactBench JSONL records. Not all fields appear in all splits — see _field_coverage for details.

context_id.description: Shared ID for all 4 examples from the same context passage.

annotation_status.description: Construction and review maturity. Archived files use candidate-oriented statuses; the provisional evaluation files use single_annotator_provisional.

annotation_notes.description: Optional revision notes. Present in some train and dev_general records.

dataset_version.description: Dataset version. Present in stress and provisional evaluation records.

legacy_subtype.description: Internal construction tag. Present in train and dev_stress.

split_field_present.note: The 'split' field does not exist in the JSONL files. Use data/example_metadata.csv for split labels.

annotation_status_present.note: The archived dev_general file lacks annotation_status. Both files under data/evaluation/preview_v0.1/ carry annotation_status=single_annotator_provisional directly.

_sidecar.description: Sidecar file providing split, dataset_version, annotation_status, and source_id for the 6,360 archived experiment examples without changing their hashes. Preview files carry reviewed annotation metadata directly.

_context_group: Each context_id maps to exactly 4 examples, one per gold_label class.
